notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Zombies.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing itself, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five untapped Zombies you control, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
